title: Something is blooming
copy: Something is blooming. New home opens in 02:19:40.
note: Countdown sticker set to launch morning. Viewers can tap to get reminded. The lotus from the site's hero, faded, on the porcelain ground. First time the new palette shows.

title: What are we up to?
copy: What are we up to? Take a guess.
note: Their own mehendi decor, blurred so it stays a tease. Poll results give a reason to post again tomorrow. Correct answer is revealed on Day 2.

title: How excited should you be?
copy: How excited should you be? Slide it.
note: The sparkler proposal frame does the work. Slider is the lowest-effort tap on Instagram, which is what a tease needs.

title: Same soul. New home.
copy: Same soul. New home. The answer was: all of the above.
note: Logo reveal, no sticker. Pays off yesterday's poll in the eyebrow. This is the frame people screenshot, so keep it clean.

title: Which one don't we do?
copy: Pop quiz: which one don't we do? A. Vendor negotiations B. Hospitality C. Tax filing D. Destination events
note: Smuggles the new services list into a joke. Three of the four are real items from the site's Scope of Services.

title: Tomorrow, 10:00
copy: Occasions that are personal & bespoke. Doors open tomorrow 10:00.
note: The site's own hero, rebuilt as a story. Anyone who tapped the Day 1 countdown gets a nudge from this one too.

title: We're live
copy: We're live. souleventsindia.com
note: Launch frame. The site's hero inside a phone, on the ink ground from the site's contact section. Link sticker is the whole point, keep it big.

title: Scroll with us
copy: Scroll with us. souleventsindia.com
note: This one is a placeholder for a phone screen recording of the live site, 12 to 15 seconds. The gallery hover reveal is the moment to catch on camera.

title: Nine kinds of occasion
copy: Nine kinds of occasion. Which should we show first?
note: Lists the gallery's nine categories as they appear on the site. The poll decides Day 4's order, so it is a real vote, not a fake one.

title: Show us your Soul moment
copy: Show us your Soul moment.
note: Add Yours chains user photos onto the launch. 450+ past clients is a lot of camera rolls. Reshare the good ones through the week.

title: Under a roof or under the trees?
copy: This or that: under a roof, or under the trees?
note: Split frame, two of their own mandaps: the red timber-pavilion one and the Namrata & Ashwin garden canopy. This-or-that is Instagram's most answered format.

title: Swing-worthy?
copy: The Taj, Mehendi. Swing-worthy?
note: The jhoola from the Taj mehendi. One word question, one slider. Location in the eyebrow is a quiet flex.

title: By the pool or on the lawn?
copy: The Marriott, brunch. By the pool, or on the lawn?
note: The cabana table beside the pool. Second poll of the day, different photo, same rhythm.

title: What's on your dream table?
copy: Table decor. What's on your dream table?
note: First open question of the week. Replies are content for Day 6 and leads for Day 7. Answer a few publicly.

title: Chelna, by Ramesh
copy: We found it easier to introduce each other than ourselves. “Chelna is a magician...” Ramesh, on Chelna.
note: The founders section, verbatim. Ink ground so it reads as a page from the site. If Chelna sends a portrait it goes behind this text.

title: Ramesh, by Chelna
copy: “Always fun, often witty, and never dull...” Chelna, on Ramesh.
note: Pair to the previous frame. Post them back to back so they read as one spread.

title: Ask Chelna & Ramesh anything
copy: Open floor. Ask Chelna & Ramesh anything.
note: The Q&A. Ramesh with a mic is the right photo for it. Answers get posted as frames on Day 6. Confirm the photo is Ramesh before using it; swap for the stage frame if not.

title: How many events have we done?
copy: By the numbers. How many events have we done? 150 / 300 / 450+ / 1000
note: Turns the stats section into a quiz. Photo is from the Holi party deck; check it reads well at story size or swap for a brunch wide.

title: Till 6 in the morning
copy: “...the party which lasted till 6 in the morning.” Anand Jain
note: Verbatim from the site's testimonials. Porcelain ground, lotus faded in the corner. No sticker; let the quote sit.

title: As though it was our own family
copy: “...as though it was a wedding from your own family.” Kalpana Rao, Dubai
note: Second voice. Same frame, so the two read as a set. Both are on the site word for word.

title: You asked, we answered
copy: You asked, we answered. (One frame per answer, reusing the question sticker.)
note: Template for the Day 5 Q&A replies. Instagram lets you reshare a question response with your answer over it; this is the layout to answer in. The example answer here is a placeholder, write the real ones.

title: Have we planned one of yours?
copy: Quick one. Have we planned one of yours?
note: Sorts the audience into past clients and prospects. The “Not yet” voters are who Day 7 talks to.

title: Tell us the date, the city, and the feeling
copy: Planning something? Tell us the date, the city, and the feeling.
note: The contact section's own line. Question box replies land in DMs, which is where a lead should land.

title: By the numbers
copy: 20 years since formation. 450+ events. 47 years of collective experience. 450+ happy clients.
note: The stats section as a story. Instagram lets you animate each number in, so post this as one frame and let the app do the reveal.

title: Just let us step in
copy: Just let us step in. A phone call is usually the fastest way to begin. WhatsApp works too.
note: The contact headline in the site's blue on ink. Two link stickers: site, and wa.me. Confirm the number is theirs before this goes up.

title: In case you missed it
copy: In case you missed it: we have a new home. souleventsindia.com
note: Closer. Pin this and the Day 3 launch frame to a “New home” highlight so the link outlives the week.
